description_en: Adds a tag to a SQL template
description_zh: 调用CreateQueryOptimizeTag接口，对目标SQL进行打标
kebab_example: aliyun das create-query-optimize-tag --engine MySQL --sql-ids 6068ce044e3dc9b903979672fb0b69df,d12515c015fc9f41a0778a9e1de00000 --tags DAS_IN_PLAN,DAS_NOT_IMPORTANT --status 1 --instance-id rm-2ze1jdv45i7l60000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateQueryOptimizeTag

parameters.help_en:
The database engine. Valid values:

MySQL: ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL

PolarDBMySQL: PolarDB for MySQL

PostgreSQL: ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL
parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎，取值：

MySQL：RDS MySQL
PolarDBMySQL：PolarDB MySQL版
PostgreSQL：RDS PostgreSQL
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en: The SQL template IDs. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/405261.html operation to obtain the SQL template ID. Separate multiple SQL template IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: SQL模板ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/405261.html接口查询SQL模板ID。支持英文逗号（,）分隔传入多个模板ID，进行批量打标
parameters.name: sql_ids

parameters.help_en:
The SQL tags. Separate multiple SQL tags with commas (,). Valid values:

DAS_IMPORTANT: The SQL template is important.

DAS_NOT_IMPORTANT: The SQL template is unimportant.

USER_IGNORE: The scheduling of the SQL template does not need to be optimized.

DAS_IN_PLAN: The scheduling of the SQL template needs to be optimized
parameters.help_zh:
SQL标签。支持英文逗号（,）分隔传入多个值。

DAS_IMPORTANT：重要SQL。
DAS_NOT_IMPORTANT：不重要SQL。
USER_IGNORE：无需优化。
DAS_IN_PLAN：排期优化
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en:
The status of Tags. Valid values:

0: removes all tags added to the SQL templates that are specified by SqlIds and leaves Tags empty.

1: adds the tags specified by Tags to the SQL templates that are specified by SqlIds
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求参数Tags的状态：

0：清空请求参数SqlIds对应的全部标签，忽略请求参数Tags设置。
1：设置请求参数SqlIds对应的标签为请求参数Tags的值
parameters.name: status

parameters.example: Slow SQL from offline synchronization. No optimization needed.
parameters.help_en:
The remarks.

The remarks can be 1 to 300 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
备注。

长度为1~300个字符
parameters.name: comments

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether the tags were added to the SQL templates.

true

false
Data.description_zh:
打标操作是否执行成功：

true：打标成功。
false：打标失败

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request was successful, Successful is returned. If the request failed, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。

请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
